verdict.rationale: Managing multiple legal entities with consolidated financials is a fair question for small-business accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions multi-entity management, intercompany handling, or consolidated reporting. The documented reports, chart of accounts, and accountant-access features are single-business capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them
